description: Ingest pipeline for session documents. Validates required fields and normalises hardware vendor strings.

script.description: Validate session documents have required identification fields
script.source: if (ctx.session_id == null || ctx.session_id.isEmpty()) { throw new Exception('session_id is required'); } if (ctx.game?.name == null || ctx.game.name.isEmpty()) { throw new Exception('game.name is required'); }

lowercase.description: Normalise GPU vendor (AMD, amd, Amd -> amd)
